beliefs: The first character is uppercased (if a letter) and preserved [E1, E2, E3]
The rest of the string is lowercased [E1, E2, E3]
'10' is inserted after the first character of the string [E1, E2, E3]
For a leading space, the space is preserved and '10' inserted after it [E2]
For a leading digit, the digit is unchanged and '10' inserted after it [E2]
For a leading symbol, it is preserved and '10' inserted after it [E1, E2]
notes: The insertion point is always after the first character (not after the first word); earlier v2 wrongly placed it after the first char but the real rule is first char + '10' + lowercased rest, which matches all observations including 'Ab c10d ef' and 'Mixedc10ase123'.
